**EFSPI Upcoming Events**

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(readxl)

events <- read_xlsx("Events.xlsx") |>
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

flextable(events) |>
  compose(
    j = "Agenda Link",
    value = as_paragraph(
      hyperlink_text(x = "Agenda",
                     url = events[["Agenda Link"]],
                     color = "blue",
                     underlined = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  compose(
    j = "Registration Link",
    value = as_paragraph(
      hyperlink_text(x = "Registration",
                     url = events[["Registration Link"]],
                     color = "blue",
                     underlined = TRUE)
    )
  )
```
